source_works.authors: Candès group official methodology site, referencing Candès, Fan, Janson and Lv (2018)
source_works.kind: primary authors' official source for Model-X requirements
source_works.version: Modeling page generated2019-05-28; referenced JRSSB80(3),551–577(2018), Panning for Gold: Model-X Knockoffs
source_works.read_scope: Modeling lines9-18 and Outline lines10-27; page also exposes Fixed-X contrast but that separate referenced paper was not read or used. Model-X PDF URL unavailable, no paper full-text reading claimed
source_works.bounded_paraphrase: The official Model-X description assumes iid feature-response observations with known covariate distribution. Knockoffs require distributional invariance under coordinate swaps and response conditional independence given original features. Importance statistics must respect swaps; the outline connects this symmetry to FDR thresholds. Independently injected noise is a legitimate exogenous empirical null but lacks matched covariate exchangeability. Repeated users, temporal drift and dependent candidate rows leave this page's theorem assumptions unestablished, so no Model-X/FDR guarantee transfers.
